segments.text: CHriſt calleth al our ſins debtes, both originall & actuall, and thoſe both of fact, and omiſſion. And they are called debts, becauſe they make vs debters to god either of obedience or puniſhment which we are to pay. For when we ſin, we doe not giue, nor perfourme vnto god, what we owe vnto him: & as long as we giue not this vnto him, ſo long we remaine debters.
